name: 500 m demonstrator
tagline: A small rocket built to pass 500 m and come back in one piece.
purpose: Prove a simple, repeatable rocket that reaches 500 m and is recovered undamaged. It is the test bed for the electronics and build methods that later projects depend on.
goals: Reach an apogee of 500 m or more
Recover the rocket with no damage
Log altitude for the whole flight
Keep every iteration documented, including the ones that fail
